Info

Stream pipeline bundle containing streaming subsystem service interfaces.

class scarajectory.setup.pipeline.stream_pipeline_bundle.StreamPipelineBundle(*, connection: IConnection, raw_channel: IStreamRawTransceiver, playback_controller: IStreamPlaybackController, binary_streamer: IBinaryProgramStreamer, dispatcher: IStreamDispatcher)[source]¶

Bases: object

Bundle containing streaming subsystem service interfaces.

It defines:

attributes:
connection - Stream connection manager interface instance.
raw_channel - Raw channel transceiver interface instance.
playback_controller - Stream playback controller interface instance.
binary_streamer - Binary program streamer interface instance.
dispatcher - Stream observer dispatcher interface instance.
